'''Lussin''' is a [[Redarm]] in [[Matrim Cauthon]]'s [[Band of the Red Hand]].

== Activities ==
He is assigned to look after [[Olver]] and [[Setalle Anan]].

== Trivia ==
* Lussin is named for Steven Lussenberg, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
